create_job_config: create a JobConfig dataclass to configure a fairchem job with run name, device type, and scheduler settings
create_scheduler_config: create a SchedulerConfig dataclass to configure local or SLURM scheduling with ranks per node and array jobs
create_slurm_config: create a SlurmConfig dataclass to configure SLURM job parameters like memory, timeout, CPUs per task, and partition
review_scheduler_type_enum: review the SchedulerType enum to choose between LOCAL and SLURM scheduling modes for fairchem jobs
review_device_type_enum: review the DeviceType enum to choose between CPU and CUDA device types for fairchem jobs
